analysis.reasonEn: Daily RSI at 41.9, entering oversold territory, continuing downtrend from 65.3 five days ago. MACD histogram worsened from 0.1334 to -0.1449, strengthening bearish signal. ADX at 17.7 indicates weak trend strength and lack of direction. Weekly RSI at 38.8, in bearish territory. Current price $8.43 is near the lower Bollinger Band at $8.06. While higher than the 52-week low of $7.21, it's significantly below the 52-week high of $41.89. Volume ratio of 0.76 relative to the 5-day average indicates subdued trading. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance for the third consecutive trading day.
